About this item

  • 【Ergonomic Full Body Support for Long Sitting】Built with 3cm high-density 70-density regenerated foam plus 2cm 28-density sponge padding, this ergonomic computer chair comes with detachable lumbar pillow and headrest to release neck & waist fatigue during long-hour gaming or office work. Designed with linkage armrests that sync with backrest recline, perfectly fit your body curve while you lean back from 90° to 135°, ideal for daily home office & gaming use.
  • 【Flexible Adjustable & 360° Swivel Design】Equipped with a heavy-duty iron frame and a stable & anti-sink gas lift, our video game chair supports 4’’ seat height adjustment and 90°-135° backrest tilt for sitting, napping and working modes. 360° smooth swivel seat paired with silent black casters allows free movement on floor without scratch, the retractable integrated footrest offers extra leg relaxation during rest.
  • 【Premium Durable Material & Strong Load-Bearing】Covered with wear-resistant premium PU leather, this big and tall gaming chair adopts sturdy all-steel inner frame plus solid black iron five-star base, tested to hold maximum 400 lbs weight safely. Thick high rebound sponge will not deform after long-term daily use, effectively avoid collapse and sagging issues common on cheap gaming office chairs.
  • 【Versatile Multi-Scene Application】This computer desk chair works perfectly for multiple scenarios: home gaming room, bedroom, personal home office, study room and game station, compatible with PC, PS5, Xbox and all mainstream game devices. Whether you are a professional gamer, remote office worker or student for daily study, this reclining gaming chair meets all your daily sitting demands.
  • 【Relax Your Arms & Legs Effortlessly】Innovative synchronized armrests automatically adjust with the reclining backrest, keeping your arms and elbows in the correct ergonomic position whether you’re sitting upright, leaning back, or lying flat. Featured with hidden built-in retractable footrest, you can pull it out easily to turn the office gaming chair into a cozy lounge recliner. Ideal for leg relaxation, short sleep or movie watching after intense gaming and tedious office tasks.
  • 【Easy Assembly & After-Sales Guarantee】Each gaming chair is packed in heavy-duty reinforced corrugated carton with complete hardware accessories and detailed step-by-step installation manual, most users finish full assembly within 30 minutes. We provide professional after-sale service for all quality problems, solve your installation and usage troubles in timely manner.

5 out of 5 stars
Comfortable and Versatile
I’m really happy with this gaming chair! It has a comfortable design and looks great in my gaming setup. The footrest is one of my favorite features because it makes it much easier to relax and stretch out my legs when I’m taking a break or watching something. The chair feels sturdy and well made, and the padding provides good support for sitting for longer periods of time. I also really like the adjustable backrest because I can change the angle depending on whether I’m gaming, working, or just relaxing. The armrests are comfortable and the overall design gives the chair a nice, professional gaming look. The footrest is easy to pull out and put away when I don’t need it, and it’s especially nice when I want to lean back and relax. Assembly was straightforward, and once everything was put together, the chair felt solid and stable. Overall, this is a great gaming chair for the price. It’s comfortable, stylish, functional, and the footrest is a great bonus. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a chair that works well for gaming, working, or relaxing.

    Solid chair but the lumbar and upper pillow might not work for everybody
    Reviewed in the United States on June 13, 2026
    Color: Grey
    Vine Customer Review of Free Product
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I've been using the same overstuffed office chair for 10 years so I thought it might be time for a change. I'm still undecided if I will keep this chair as my main piece of furniture or not.

    It was well packaged, and easy to assemble. There are a lot of pieces, but the way that the screws are labeled makes it very easy to get it together. The under chair pullout leg rest was a little tricky, but trust the process, it folds under when stored and flips out if you want it extended.

    The base is steel and very sturdy, I don't think I'll have any problems anytime soon with the construction.

    the arms and back went together well but I'm a little underwhelmed with the amount of padding in the actual chair seating surface and the back. The lumbar support is a nice touch but for me, it is nowhere near where it needs to be and just feels awkward. I feel the same way about the pull out leg rest, it just doesn't fit me well as a 6'4" individual, somebody much smaller might have a better time.

    Without the pillows, it is an alright chair but the contours of the seating surface look much more comfortable in the pictures. For the price, it is decent, think it is better for a smaller human who might not be looking for all that much support.

About this Item

  • 【Ergonomic Full Body Support for Long Sitting】Built with 3cm high-density 70-density regenerated foam plus 2cm 28-density sponge padding, this ergonomic computer chair comes with detachable lumbar pillow and headrest to release neck & waist fatigue during long-hour gaming or office work. Designed with linkage armrests that sync with backrest recline, perfectly fit your body curve while you lean back from 90° to 135°, ideal for daily home office & gaming use.
  • 【Flexible Adjustable & 360° Swivel Design】Equipped with a heavy-duty iron frame and a stable & anti-sink gas lift, our video game chair supports 4’’ seat height adjustment and 90°-135° backrest tilt for sitting, napping and working modes. 360° smooth swivel seat paired with silent black casters allows free movement on floor without scratch, the retractable integrated footrest offers extra leg relaxation during rest.
  • 【Premium Durable Material & Strong Load-Bearing】Covered with wear-resistant premium PU leather, this big and tall gaming chair adopts sturdy all-steel inner frame plus solid black iron five-star base, tested to hold maximum 400 lbs weight safely. Thick high rebound sponge will not deform after long-term daily use, effectively avoid collapse and sagging issues common on cheap gaming office chairs.
  • 【Versatile Multi-Scene Application】This computer desk chair works perfectly for multiple scenarios: home gaming room, bedroom, personal home office, study room and game station, compatible with PC, PS5, Xbox and all mainstream game devices. Whether you are a professional gamer, remote office worker or student for daily study, this reclining gaming chair meets all your daily sitting demands.
  • 【Relax Your Arms & Legs Effortlessly】Innovative synchronized armrests automatically adjust with the reclining backrest, keeping your arms and elbows in the correct ergonomic position whether you’re sitting upright, leaning back, or lying flat. Featured with hidden built-in retractable footrest, you can pull it out easily to turn the office gaming chair into a cozy lounge recliner. Ideal for leg relaxation, short sleep or movie watching after intense gaming and tedious office tasks.
  • 【Easy Assembly & After-Sales Guarantee】Each gaming chair is packed in heavy-duty reinforced corrugated carton with complete hardware accessories and detailed step-by-step installation manual, most users finish full assembly within 30 minutes. We provide professional after-sale service for all quality problems, solve your installation and usage troubles in timely manner.

Product Description

Our ergonomic gaming chair is engineered for modern adult gamers and home office workers, combining durable PU leather, layered high-density sponge cushion, solid steel construction and practical adjustable functions.

Featuring linkage synchronized armrests, retractable footrest, removable headrest and lumbar cushion, 90°~135° adjustable backrest and height adjustable gas lift, our computer chair delivers all-day comfy sitting experience for gaming, working, reading and short rest.

With 400LBS strong weight capacity and stable iron five-star base, this high back video game chair effectively solves waist soreness, stiff neck caused by long sitting, widely used in home, game room and private office.

135° reclining backrest for working, gaming, reading, or resting, 360° swivel seat provides adjustable height for different users. Designed with a retractable footrest for optimal leg relaxation, Padded linkage armrests that effortlessly adjust to support your arms at any angle.

The stable gas lift cylinder ensures smooth height adjustment, comes with a 5-claw base that evenly distributes overall pressure, equipped with universal wheels for effortless, low-noise movement.

All parts are well packed in thick carton for safe transportation, easy installation with full set of spare parts included.

Note: The gaming chair requires assembly
